text:
Eventful run or not, we appreciate your full message and we are sorry the trip left you feeling let down. You explained that the handling of your companion animal and the support around the change in arrangements did not match the care you expected from Aurelia Skyways. We take that seriously, because the comfort and safety of every animal matter on every journey.

<<FACT F120>> We have also reviewed the notes already entered by our team, and the record shows where the service fell short in communication. A welfare coordinator will look again at the comfort details tied to your case, and the desk will keep the review calm, careful, and practical. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, so when anything seems unclear, our staff are expected to pause, check the details, and act with the animal's wellbeing in mind.

We are sorry that you had to chase answers instead of feeling supported. Your complaint has been passed along for follow-up through the normal review path, and the desk will make sure the service changes are kept on record. Thank you for bringing this to our attention, because that is how we improve the experience for travelers and their companions alike.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
